name: Gqom x Trance Broken Drive
desc: FUSES gqom's broken ViscoSpaceDrum kicks (drums.gqom.broken_kicks) with trance's offbeat open hats and 16th drive (drums.trance.driving): the kick refuses four-to-the-floor while the hats insist on it.

code.full: stack(s("<[bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~ bd ~] [bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~ ~ bd] [bd ~ bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~] [bd ~ ~ bd ~ bd bd ~]>").bank("ViscoSpaceDrum").shape(${drive}).gain(${gain}), s("[~ oh]*4").bank("RolandTR909").decay(.18).gain(${hats}), s("hh*8").bank("RolandTR909").gain(saw.range(${hats}*.4,${hats}*.8).fast(4))).lpf(9000).every(8, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(1).play()
code.peak: stack(s("<[bd ~ bd bd ~ ~ bd ~] [bd ~ ~ bd ~ bd bd ~]>").bank("ViscoSpaceDrum").shape(${drive}*1.2).gain(${gain}), s("[~ oh]*4").bank("RolandTR909").decay(.22).gain(${hats}*1.1), s("hh*16").bank("RolandTR909").gain(saw.range(${hats}*.45,${hats}*.85).fast(4)), s("~ ~ ~ [~ cp]").bank("RolandTR909").gain(${hats})).lpf(11000).lastOf(4, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(1).play()
